title: Neuronal control of Drosophila walking direction
source_locator: Abstract (Europe PMC record; Science full text paywalled)
quote: is sufficient to trigger backward walking under conditions in which flies would otherwise walk forward
mapping_basis: MDN is itself a MANC type name in type_list.csv (other name DNp50).
effector: heat activation (effector not named in abstract; IMP press release: activated by heat at 30 C)
stimulation: 30 C vs 24 C (per IMP press release); not stated in abstract

title: Neural circuit mechanisms underlying context-specific halting in Drosophila
quote: drove robust halting as reflected by decrease in walking velocity, distance and rotation (Fig. 1a–d
mapping_basis: Kit maps BB/bluebell (Sapkal 2024) to two MANC types (DNg60 and DNxn073; SS31326 AMBIGUOUS in driver_lines.csv); paper text seen gives no MANC type and anatomy ('SEZ neurons that stochastically descend') does not decide, so UNMAPPED.
stimulation: 630 nm red light pulsed 50 Hz, 0.038 mW/mm2, 10 s ON / 50 s OFF x5
notes: Paper says split lines targeted FG, BB, BRK 'with little to no ectopic expression'. Driver ID taken from kit driver_lines.csv (Sapkal Supplementary table row 3); I could not open the supplementary table myself. Paper: 'Both FG and BB ... are SEZ neurons that stochastically descend until the anterior tip of the nerve cord.' Kit candidate types: DNg60; DNxn073. Coactivation experiments (BB + MDN/P9/BPN) not recorded as separate records.

title: Neural circuit mechanisms underlying context-specific halting in Drosophila
quote: However, decapitated P9-activated flies do not show the phenotypic forward turning (Extended Data Fig. 6e).
mapping_basis: Paper names the neuron DNp09 (Namiki name); kit maps the name DNp09 to MANC DNp09 and also lists it as the hemibrain name for DNp71, and the P9 line is AMBIGUOUS (DNp09;DNp71) in driver_lines.csv; chose DNp09 as named by the paper.
n_flies_note: n = 7-10 flies per genotype (Extended Data Fig. 6e legend)
notes: Text says only that decapitated P9 flies lack the forward turning phenotype and that 'unlike P9, the VNC outputs of these DNs [oDN1, BDN2] are sufficient for forward walking'; whether any leg movement remained is not stated, so legs coded unclear and category no_visible_effect is tentative.
